title: Email queue pressure: system notes

Operational recovery: Route both classes through the prior shared queue if the new routing fails, with priority alerts active.
context: Internal service documentation for the notification worker, maintained as part of a reproducible training corpus.
decision: Document diagnosis and validation steps for email queue pressure.
reasoning: This document separates observations from opinions so future engineers can verify an earlier diagnosis. Unlimited retries can starve fresh traffic.
